explanation: The survey view no longer derives its own data. expressionSurvey.ts is the pure derivation module: selectSources (collection, region, SFO boundary, AgRP and tissue-preparation filters), catalogEntries, surveyPanel (ranked rows, bar axis, per-probe matrix cells, the Matched X -> Y note, empty states) and surveyExport (samples/cohort-means CSV and values + metadata JSON, survey CSV escaping unchanged). Reference eligibility is applied once through inReferenceScope and value status has one ValueStatus code-to-label mapping. useSurveyLoad.ts owns the four-request source queue, per-source errors and a per-source retry; useKeyedLoad and useExternalValidation give the catalog, validation reports and sample metadata their own cancelled-flag lifecycles and retries, replacing the single shared reload token. Loader imports and signatures are unchanged; export bytes are unchanged.
